summary: Our project, Rocket To MARS, is an interactive educational game designed to make the complex engineering trade-offs of a Martian mission tangible and fun for students. We address the challenge of simplified STEM content by creating a sandbox environment where players must design, build, and fly a rocket to Mars, balancing competing demands like power, fuel management, and strength of the engine. By utilizing NASA open data sets on Martian atmospheric density, orbital mechanics, and propulsion metrics, we provide an engaging, scientifically accurate experience that challenges students to make the critical decisions that determine whether a mission succeeds or fails.
